description: JWST M_dyn prediction with REVISED F_p (v2.7.52+)
method: F_p(0) revised from 0.7 to 0.9993. M_dyn = F_p × 5×M_b + F_s × f_back×E_SN/c^2.
result_summary: M_dyn/M_b ~ 4.99 for all JWST massive quiescents (was 2.67-4.65 with F_p=0.7). Almost all DM is primordial.
interpretation: With F_p(0) = 0.9993, the cascade predicts M_dyn/M_b is essentially the primordial ratio (5×M_b), with a negligible cumulative contribution. This is more consistent with the cascade's "DM = past SF" rule applied at the 4D event (primordial SFH).
